categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in maritime engineering vessel leasing, offshore wind farm nearshore and offshore construction, various submarine cable engineering, and maritime engineering project management. Its services include vessel leasing for offshore wind power projects, engineering contracts for wind farm development and submarine cable installation, and long-term operation and maintenance (O&M) services. The company also manages a cable maintenance base and provides integrated lifecycle services for submarine cables.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced maritime engineering technologies including specialized vessels such as personnel transport ships, tugboats, transport barges, survey ships, operation and maintenance support vessels (SOVs), heavy engineering support vessels, and flexible pipe/submarine cable installation ships. It employs project management expertise and integrates cable laying, burial, maintenance, and repair technologies, including the use of remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) for underwater cable work. The company maintains ISO certifications (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) to ensure quality, environmental, and occupational safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are offshore wind farm developers, telecommunications companies, and integrated engineering contractors primarily in Taiwan. The company serves the renewable energy sector, especially offshore wind power, and also extends services to the oil and gas industry in Europe. Major contracts include long-term vessel leasing agreements with wind turbine operators like Vestas and large submarine cable projects for companies such as Chunghwa Telecom.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Taiwan, with expanding operations in Asia (including Japan and South Korea) and Europe. It has established a European operational base through partnerships and vessel deployment, notably in Norway, to serve offshore wind and oil and gas markets. The company holds exclusive operation rights for a submarine cable maintenance zone at Taichung Port in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the offshore wind power and maritime engineering supply chain. It provides integrated services including vessel leasing, engineering construction, and long-term operation and maintenance, acting as a key service integrator between equipment manufacturers and wind farm operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its fleet and maritime engineering talent, enhancing service quality, and diversifying markets beyond Taiwan to Europe and Asia. It emphasizes sustainable development, technological capability in cable installation and maintenance, and long-term O&M contracts to stabilize cash flow. R&D is service and technology-oriented, focusing on operational efficiency and integration rather than product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through vessel leasing contracts, engineering project contracts (including turnkey submarine cable projects), and long-term operation and maintenance service agreements. The company also earns income from managing port facilities dedicated to cable maintenance and from providing integrated lifecycle services for offshore wind and submarine cable projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading maritime engineering service provider in Taiwan and the Asia-Pacific region, especially in offshore wind support vessels. It faces competition in personnel transport and medium-sized work vessels from local and foreign operators but holds a dominant position in large-scale engineering and cable installation vessels. Its integrated service model and fleet scale create high entry barriers, positioning it as a top-tier player in the offshore wind maritime engineering sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown strong financial growth with 113th fiscal year revenue reaching approximately NT$6.89 billion, a 40% increase from the previous year, and net profit of about NT$1.23 billion, up 24%. Total assets grew by 12.7% to NT$7.92 billion, and equity increased by 44% to NT$5.17 billion. The company has successfully raised capital through multiple equity issuances to fund fleet expansion and operational growth, maintaining a stable and improving financial structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, integrated maritime engineering solutions covering vessel leasing, engineering construction, and full lifecycle cable services, uniquely positioning itself as Taiwan's only provider of full submarine cable lifecycle services. Its large, diverse fleet and experienced project teams provide high reliability and efficiency. Long-term contracts and strategic international partnerships enhance its competitive edge, enabling it to deliver stable cash flows and expand into new markets such as Europe and the oil and gas sector.
